Inside, beneath a cork and a twist of faded blue cloth, the keeper found a note written in a careful hand: “If this reaches you, tell my sister the garden still blooms.” No name, no date, only a small drawing of a window with three panes. He read it twice, then carried it upstairs and set it beside the lamp. For days he watched the sea, hoping the message had not traveled alone. At last, on a clear evening, a fishing boat entered the harbor. Its oldest sailor saw the drawing and went pale. He knew the window. The keeper folded the note and went down to meet him.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市还没有醒透。高楼的窗子一格格暗着，路灯把潮湿的街面照成淡金色。清洁车缓缓驶过，水声贴着路沿散开；远处面包铺升起一缕白汽，像谁在夜里轻轻叹气。公交站牌下，有人抱着外套等车，眼神沉静。偶尔一辆出租车掠过，车尾灯转过街角，很快消失。天边仍是深蓝，楼群的轮廓却已渐渐清楚。这个时辰没有白日的喧闹，也没有深夜的安稳，万物都在将醒未醒之间。","w03":"- Recursion is when a recipe or set of instructions uses itself as a smaller step.\n- To count down, say a number, then use the same rule to count down from one less.\n- Stop at zero; that stopping rule keeps the instructions from going on forever."}
